def: The sum of the rewards from a step onwards, optionally discounted by a factor gamma for each step of delay.
The expected return from a state if the current policy is followed afterwards, a learned prediction of how well things will go from here.
The action value minus the state value: how much better than the policy's average an action was in that state.
The consistency condition that the value of a state equals the expected next reward plus the discounted value of the next state.
The critic's surprise at one step: reward plus discounted next value minus the current value, used both to train the critic and as a one-step advantage.
Updating an estimate towards a target that itself contains an estimate, such as a reward plus the critic's value of the next state.
The actual sum of rewards observed until the end of an episode, an unbiased but high-variance target for a value or advantage.
An advantage estimator that sums future TD errors with weights (gamma times lambda) to the power of their delay, trading critic bias against sampling noise.
A number between 0 and 1 (gamma) by which each step of delay shrinks a future reward; language-model RL usually uses 1.
A linear layer on a language model's hidden states that outputs one predicted return per token position instead of vocabulary logits.
The regression target for the critic in PPO, equal to the GAE advantage plus the value predicted when the data was collected.
